body.heading: Why family is different
paragraphs: With family, you are never just discussing today's issue. You are also negotiating years of habits, roles, and things said at other tables. That is why a small comment can land like a much bigger one.
Naming that helps: 'I know we always joke about this, but I want to say it seriously for a minute.' Framing the conversation gives everyone a chance to actually listen.

body.heading: Habits that help
paragraphs: Talk about one thing at a time, and describe behaviour rather than character. 'When plans change at the last minute, I get stressed' lands better than 'You're so unreliable.'
End with what you hope for, not just what hurt. 'I want us to be able to talk about this' reminds everyone — including you — that the relationship is the point.

description: Family makes hard conversations harder — old roles, old patterns. A few habits keep them honest and kind.
